task_name: the Spanish copy and the rows of the ranking

rubric.result: The objective promises three things and all three are in the diff. Text: `coverageHeadline` in web/src/format.ts turns `measured` into `80,0 %` / `72,4 %` (Intl es-ES, one decimal fixed), `no-artifact` into 'Sin datos de cobertura' and `unreadable-artifact` into 'Artefacto de cobertura ilegible'; `coverageAge` answers 'sin fecha' for a null `measuredAt` and otherwise delegates to the `relativeDays` that already existed, reused and not rewritten. Geometry: `ChampionRows.toRow` sets `barPercent` to the percentage, 0 when there is none. One place, no component deciding: no component is touched by this task, and every row decision (name fallback to the id, headline, age, source, bar, selected) is taken inside champion-rows.ts. One plan-internal wrinkle, recorded and not charged to the diff: the Verification sentence says 'the copy lives only in web/src/format.ts', while the brief's own Contract puts `ChampionRows.emptyHeadline()` and its literal sentence 'Ningun clon trae datos de cobertura.' in champion-rows.ts. The diff obeys the Contract, which is what item 3 measures; the two sentences of the brief cannot both be satisfied.

The TDD line names `test('a clone with no artifact is shown as sin datos de cobertura')` in web/src/format.test.ts and demands the whole distinctive sentence, not a substring. The test body is `expect(coverageHeadline('no-artifact', null)).toBe('Sin datos de cobertura')` — the full sentence, compared with `toBe`, so no substring match. The TDD line also fixes the one-decimal rule with two cases either side of the boundary: the diff has `coverageHeadline('measured', 72.35)` expecting '72,4 %' and `coverageHeadline('measured', 72.34)` expecting '72,3 %', both in `test('a coverage is rounded to one decimal at the boundary')`. Same input, same expected value as written in the plan.

The Contract block for web/src/champion-rows.ts matches name by name. `ChampionRow` declares exactly id, name, headline, age, source, barPercent, selected, with the same types and the same order as the brief. `ChampionRows.of(coverage: readonly RepoCoverage[], repos: readonly Clone[], repoId: string, now: Date): ChampionRow[]` — parameter names, order, readonly modifiers and return type identical. `ChampionRows.emptyHeadline(): string` returns the literal the brief fixes, 'Ningun clon trae datos de cobertura.' (with the accented N and the closing full stop). The three copy literals the brief fixes for `coverageHeadline` are literal matches, and `coverageAge`'s 'sin fecha' too. `CoverageState` is imported from web/src/api/types.ts, where it is the closed union 'measured' | 'no-artifact' | 'unreadable-artifact', so the switch covers exactly the declared members.

Row by row: 'Order of the ranking' is the server's job and this task explicitly keeps what the server sent — `ChampionRows.of` maps `coverage` in place with no sort, and `test('the order the server sent is kept untouched')` pins it, so the row is honoured and not reopened. 'Metric: lines only, rounded to one decimal' is honoured on the display side by the Intl formatter with minimum and maximum fraction digits both 1. 'Spanish is only for UI copy' holds: every identifier, comment and test name is English, and the only Spanish is inside the copy literals the plan itself fixes. 'No candidate counts -> state no-artifact, every value null' and 'unreadable-artifact' both get their own branch in `coverageHeadline`, and neither is ever rendered as 0 %: the absent percentage produces a sentence, not a number. The remaining rows (route, formats, candidate order, cache key, server module tree) bear on server code this task does not touch, and an untouched row is not a finding.

Exemplars: web/src/format.ts is imitated exactly — the new functions are the same shape as `heatFooter` / `fallbackNotice`, exported, pure, taking `now` as a parameter instead of reading the clock, with the Intl formatter hoisted to a module constant the way `dayFormatter` and `monthFormatter` already are. web/src/champion-rows.ts plays the role web/src/heat-rows.ts plays for Calor (pure row arithmetic kept out of the component so it can be pinned with exact values); it differs in hanging its functions off a `ChampionRows` type where heat-rows.ts uses free functions, and that is the correct resolution — conventions/style.md requires 'No free function at module level: every function hangs off a type', and where an exemplar and a rule disagree the rule wins. web/src/api/types.ts is honoured: the payload types are imported from web/, nothing from server/. Repo rules (AGENTS.md): code in English and Spanish only for product copy — held; relative imports in web/ carry no .js suffix — held ('./champion-rows', './api/types', './format'); Vitest tests beside the code — held; web/ never imports from server/ — held; no author name or email anywhere in the diff — held. conventions/architecture.md on the one new module: champion-rows.ts is one concept plus the type that has no meaning without it (delete `ChampionRows` and `ChampionRow` has no consumer), it has no input/output, no React, no clock read, and it receives `now` and `repoId` as data rather than reaching for them. conventions/decisions.md: the coverage copy exists once (format.ts) and the row decisions once (`ChampionRows.toRow`); the bar arithmetic here (absolute per cent) is not the same decision as heat-rows.ts's `barWidth` (relative to the hottest row), so no business change forces touching both — idiom, not a spread rule. conventions/style.md: champion-rows.ts and its test carry no prose at all. format.ts is a pre-existing module with a module docstring and free functions, i.e. the repository's declared debt on exactly this document's three rules, so the new `/** `72,4 %`, one decimal always shown, comma of `es-ES`. */` comment and the free functions follow the style of their host and are not a finding; and this is not a new concept smuggled into an old file — turning an API payload value into Spanish copy is precisely what format.ts already is, and the brief names it as the place. conventions/defects.md, rule by rule: (1) closed vocabulary — `coverageHeadline` dispatches over the `CoverageState` union with a switch that has no catch-all branch, so a new member fails the type checker; the residual `percentage === null ? '—'` inside the 'measured' case is an optional standing in for a state, and its cause is that web/src/api/types.ts declares `percentage`, `source` and `measuredAt` nullable independently of `state`. That file is not in this task's `**Files:**`, so the branch is forced on the diff by a shape it may not change: recorded here, not charged as a finding. (2) raw map as the return value of logic — none: the answer is the declared `ChampionRow` interface, and `ChampionRows.of` returns an array of those, not an object literal keyed by hand. (3) two fields that have to agree — the row's `source: ''` and `barPercent: 0` are sentinel values for an absence, and both are fixed by the brief's Contract (`source: string`, `barPercent: number`) and by `test('a clone with no percentage gets no bar')`; the diff cannot satisfy both the Contract and this rule, so it is declared here and not counted, and no consumer has to keep two fields in agreement because each row is built once, in one method. (4) an error named for where it happens — no subject: this diff raises and declares no error. conventions/testing.md: the objects the new test needs come from `CoverageMother` and `CloneMother`, whose methods are named scenarios (`measured`, `noArtifact`, `of`) rather than one fully defaulted builder; the helpers hang off those types; the assertions are on the returned rows, not on a reimplemented model. Delivery: this task adds two new symbols and one new module and changes no existing signature or call site, so there is no old path left behind for any expand-contract rule to speak about.

One test file that already existed is touched, web/src/format.test.ts, and it is a test file by path and by contents (it imports from 'vitest' and is all `test(...)` blocks). Its hunks are `@@ -1,14 +1,16 @@` and `@@ -141,10 +143,31 @@`, and both are pure additions: the only lines the diff adds to the head are `coverageAge,` and `coverageHeadline,` inside the import list, and the second hunk appends five new tests after `test('the fallback notice names the folder it fell back to')`. No `-` line removes, relaxes or rewrites any assertion, case or test — the pre-existing tests of the file are untouched context. The single `-` line in the whole diff is in web/src/format.ts and it is the import statement, replaced by the same statement plus `CoverageState`.

The promised behaviour is produced by production code. The copy comes from `coverageHeadline` and `coverageAge` in web/src/format.ts and the geometry from `ChampionRows.toRow` in web/src/champion-rows.ts; the test files only build inputs (`CoverageMother`, `CloneMother`) and read the answer back. Nothing is stubbed or mocked: `ChampionRows.of` is called for real with real `RepoCoverage` and `Clone` values, and the expected values in the assertions ('80,0 %', '72,4 %', '72,3 %', 'Sin datos de cobertura', 'Artefacto de cobertura ilegible', 'sin fecha', [false, true], [0], ['b','a'], 'Ningun clon trae datos de cobertura.') are the answers of those functions, not values the test also computes. Revert web/src/format.ts and web/src/champion-rows.ts and every one of the nine tests fails to resolve or fails outright.

The diff writes inside the four declared files and nothing beyond what the task's sentences ask for. web/src/format.ts gains only `coveragePercentFormatter`, `coveragePercentage`, `coverageHeadline` and `coverageAge` — the three sentences plus the age the task names; `coveragePercentage` is not extra work but the formatting the '72,4 %' sentence requires, exported the way every other function of that module is exported. web/src/champion-rows.ts holds exactly the Contract and nothing else: no sort (the task says the order comes from the server untouched), no row limit, no clock read, no React. No refactor, rename or adjacent fix rides along: nothing pre-existing in format.ts is rewritten. `### Out of scope` names running coverage tools, reading coverage from CI, history or trend, per-folder coverage, thresholds and JaCoCo, and the diff touches none of them. The `percentage === null ? '—'` branch inside the 'measured' case is not code the task asked for either, but it is the minimum the type checker demands given web/src/api/types.ts, which this task may not touch — so it is the shape of the out-of-scope type showing through, not extra scope taken.

The skill `control-tower-loop:test-driven-development` did not load ('Unknown skill'), so one yardstick did not arrive and I report only the three properties that block, which were never the skill's to supply. Nine new tests: five appended to web/src/format.test.ts and four in the new web/src/champion-rows.test.ts. Deterministic — no clock read, no network, no filesystem, no randomness, no sleep: every date is a literal (`new Date('2026-08-19T12:00:00Z')` for `now`, '2026-08-19T00:00:00Z' as the mother's `measuredAt`), and the Intl formatter is pinned to 'es-ES' with both fraction digits fixed at 1. Isolated — each test builds its own inputs through the mothers, the only module-level state is the immutable `now` constant, nothing is written or reset anywhere, and no test needs another to have run first: they pass in any order. Verifies real behaviour — every assertion is on the value the production functions return, never on a mock's call count, a stub's answer or a constant the test just defined; none of them would survive reverting the production lines of this diff. Beyond the three, the finer half is not reported for the reason above.
